ORAL ORDER 3 10-04-2025 Heard the parties.
Patna High Court CR.

. The present application has been filed for setting aside the order dated 13.06.2022 passed by the Court of S.D.J.M., Manjhaul (Begusarai), by which the learned court below has accepted the final form submitted by the police officer exonerating the accused persons (respondent no. 5 to 14) in connection with Khodavanpur P.S. Case No. 54/2004 dated 29.07.2004 for the offences under Sections 420, 468, 341, 323, 379, 504/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code, without examining the merits of the protest petition filed on behalf of the informant.
3. From the entire ordersheet, it appears that the informant did not appear in the Court of the Magistrate at the stage of acceptance of final form and therefore, the final form has been accepted.
4. However, the petitioner has remedy of filing of complaint case after acceptance of final form.
5. This application is dismissed with liberty to the petitioner to file a complaint case in the matter in the Court below.
